news.analysis: As a passer, McCord didn't do anything to severly hurt the Dolphins. He didn't do anything much to help them either. It'll be tough to start any Dolphin next week against the Bills.

news.analysis: Henry was incredibly inefficient on Monday night, racking up just 20 yards on 15 total touches. He was able to get two goal-line touchdowns over the course of the game, which left him with a good fantasy total when paired with his five receptions. He should continue to get all of the work in this backfield moving forward, but his efficiency and Baltimore's offensive struggles will call into question his game-to-game consistency.

news.contents: Baltimore Ravens running back Derrick Henry posted 10 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 10 carries in Monday night's 23-20 defeat to the Los Angeles Chargers. He hauled in all five of his targets for an additional 10 yards. Yikes. Henry lost two yards on Baltimore's first play from scrimmage, foreshadowing one of the most inefficient games of his illustrious career. Kyle McCord remains Miami's starter.
